research.job_description_summary: HCLTech hires freshers through graduate hiring (B.E./B.Tech/MCA/B.Sc., Graduate Engineer Trainee and similar roles) and through the TechBee programme for Class 12 pass-outs. A 2026 guide describes graduate hiring as an online assessment (aptitude, reasoning, verbal, technical MCQs and often one or two coding problems), a technical interview and an HR round; TechBee as an entrance test (aptitude, basic English, computer awareness) followed by an interview. The official HCLTech careers pages were located but not fetched.
limitations: Official HCLTech careers and fresher pages were located but not fetched, so no round is marked DOCUMENTED; rounds are REPORTED from a 2026 freshershunt guide and a GeeksforGeeks guide (published 2023-11-22, last updated 2026-07-31).

The only dated candidate-attributed account found is a single Glassdoor review (2025-12-20, Java GET, easy): HR screening, Java technical (OOP, collections, exception handling, simple logic) and HR (self-introduction, email writing, location). Those items are class B, unverified, one report each.
The GeeksforGeeks page is a general guide, not a candidate experience; its sample questions are editorial and used as topic context (class D).
No source gives per-question counts. Freshershunt says frequently asked questions are collected on a separate page that was not found.
The 'HCL' (1) and 'HCL Tech' (6) entries in the CodeArena company list look like duplicates; this bank is delivered as 'HCL Tech' and the two should be merged on your side.
TechBee content is a proposed structure from a single guide; no TechBee candidate reports were found.
Package figures and the service-agreement terms differ between sources and were not used.

Evidence handling: practice questions cite no sources; where a source only supplied topic context it is named in the question notes. Practice and job-description-inferred questions are UNVERIFIED and capped at LOW confidence on import.

Review status: answers, samples and cited counts come from the researcher and were not independently re-run; spot checks only. Source titles and some dates are blank because the sources did not show them.
